description: Frequency inverter: running values, monitor parameters, run and stop commands, frequency command, status, faults, basic and communication settings
source: Metaltex IF20 operation manual (Portuguese), parameter tables and appendix B (communication protocol)

sources.title: Manual de Operação – IF20
sources.note: linked in issue #443; parameter tables (group D0, P0, PD) and appendix B

notes: Modbus RTU on RS485. Function 03 reads and 06 writes. Factory serial settings: 9600 baud (PD.00 = 5), 8N1 (PD.01 = 3), address 1 (PD.02).

Parameter addresses: high byte 0xF0 to 0xFF for groups P0 to PF, 0xA0 to 0xAF for groups C, 0x70 to 0x7F for groups D (read only); low byte is the parameter number. P3.12 is 0xF30C. Writing to 0x0nnn (P groups) or 0x4nnn (C groups) changes the value in RAM only, without wearing the EEPROM.
To run the inverter over Modbus set P0.02 = 2 and P0.04 = 9; then write the command to 0x2000 and the frequency to 0x1000.
Only part of the parameter list is in the map: the monitor group D0, the main P0 settings and the communication group PD. Other parameters follow the address rule above.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.description: 1 to 249; 0 is broadcast. The parameter table gives no address for group PD; this is the address from the manual's rule (0xF0 + group, parameter number).

registers.description: 0 to 20.0 ms. The parameter table gives no address for group PD; this is the address from the manual's rule (0xF0 + group, parameter number).

registers.name: PD.04 Response timeout
registers.description: 0.0 (off) or 0.1 to 60.0 s; past it the inverter trips with CE. The parameter table gives no address for group PD; this is the address from the manual's rule (0xF0 + group, parameter number).
